description: An agent-based, network-embedded social simulation of mask-wearing adoption driven by social influence, information campaigns, retailer availability, household dynamics, movement across locations, and policy mandates with enforcement.

modules.name: NetworkConstruction
modules.description: Constructs the person-to-person contact network used for social influence and information spread.

modules.name: InformationModule
modules.description: Propagates information and misinformation affecting risk perception and trust.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  info_signal = messaging_intensity * policy_maker_credibility * media_reach * message_frequency_per_day
  misinfo_signal = misinformation_prevalence * misinformation_effect_strength * message_frequency_per_day
  # Update exposures
  i.exposure_to_information = (1 - info_decay_rate) * i.exposure_to_information + info_signal
  i.exposure_to_misinformation = (1 - info_decay_rate) * i.exposure_to_misinformation + misinfo_signal
  # Update risk perception (bounded [0,1])
  delta_risk = risk_perception_sensitivity * (info_signal - misinfo_signal)
  i.risk_perception = clip(i.risk_perception + delta_risk, 0, 1)
  # Update trust (bounded [0,1])
  delta_trust = 0.5 * policy_maker_credibility * messaging_intensity - 0.5 * misinformation_effect_strength * misinformation_prevalence
  i.trust_in_authority = clip(i.trust_in_authority + delta_trust, 0, 1)
notes: This module shifts perceptions additively and decays exposures.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Applies peer effects and norm updates based on neighbors' mask wearing.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  neighbor_states = [adoption_state(j) for j in neighbors(i)]
  neighbor_adoption = mean(neighbor_states) if len(neighbor_states)>0 else 0
  # Update perceived social norm and conformity
  norm_delta = norm_update_rate * (neighbor_adoption - 0.5)
  i.conformity_trait = clip(i.conformity_trait + norm_delta + Normal(0, observation_noise_sd), 0, 1)
  # Update perceived cost downwards when many peers adopt (visibility reduces perceived hassle)
  i.perceived_cost = clip(i.perceived_cost - social_influence_weight * (neighbor_adoption - 0.5), 0, 1)
notes: Observation noise prevents lock-in and allows variance.
This does not change adoption_state directly; DecisionModule does.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcementModule
modules.description: Controls mandate status and enforces policy at locations with penalties or entry denial.

notes: Mandate status is a global boolean updated daily.
Penalties increase perceived cost aversion in DecisionModule via compliance_sensitivity_to_penalty.

modules.name: MovementAndContextModule
modules.description: Moves agents among home, work, and public locations and applies location-level signage effects.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  current_type = type_of(location(i))
  probs = transitions[current_type]
  next_type = categorical_sample(['home','work','public'], probs)
  i.location_id = assign_to_random_location_of_type(next_type, capacity_weighted=True)
  # Signage effect: reduce perceived_cost slightly in stricter locations
  L = get_location(i.location_id)
  i.perceived_cost = clip(i.perceived_cost - within_location_norm_weight * L.policy_strictness * 0.05, 0, 1)
notes: Movement is a first-order Markov process.

modules.name: RetailMarketModule
modules.description: Handles mask inventory dynamics at retailers and selling transactions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# Restock
for each Retailer R:
  restock_qty = max(0, Normal(retailer_restock_rate_per_day, retailer_restock_std)) * population_size * (initial_retailer_stock_per_capita/ simulation_duration_days)
  R.stock_level += restock_qty
# Sell to queued requests
for each Person i with purchase_request:
  R = nearest_retailer(i)
  if R.stock_level <= stockout_threshold: mark_stockout(R)
  purch_limit = retailer_rationing_limit if retailer_rationing_enabled else INF
  affordable_qty = floor(budget_function(i.income, mask_price))
  qty = min(purch_limit, affordable_qty, R.stock_level)
  R.stock_level -= qty
  i.mask_inventory += qty
retailer_stockout_share = (#Retailers with stock_level <= stockout_threshold) / retailer_count
notes: Budget function can be a simple fraction of income (e.g., 0.001*income).
Restock rate parameter scales expected daily restock to population.

modules.name: HouseholdModule
modules.description: Aligns household norms and pools mask resources among members.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Household H:
  member_states = [adoption_state(m) for m in H.members]
  H.household_norms = mean(member_states)
  # Pool resources with efficiency
  total_masks = sum(mask_inventory(m) for m in H.members)
  effective_masks = total_masks * resource_pooling_efficiency
  redistribute masks to minimize zero-inventory among members using effective_masks
  # Adjust each member's perceived_cost toward household_norms
  for m in H.members:
    delta = household_norm_weight * (H.household_norms - 0.5)
    m.perceived_cost = clip(m.perceived_cost - delta, 0, 1)
notes: Redistribution prioritizes members with expected upcoming need (e.g., workers).

modules.name: DecisionModule
modules.description: Computes individual decisions to wear masks and to purchase based on perceptions, costs, policy pressure, and inventory.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  # Utility to wear mask
  peer_term = conformity_trait_weight * i.conformity_trait
  risk_term = i.risk_perception
  policy_term = (1 if mandate_active else 0) * i.trust_in_authority * compliance_sensitivity_to_penalty
  cost_term = i.perceived_cost + price_sensitivity * mask_price
  inventory_constraint = 1 if i.mask_inventory > 0 else -10
  utility = risk_term + peer_term + policy_term + inventory_constraint - cost_term
  p_wear = sigmoid(utility)
  i.adoption_state = 1 if Bernoulli(p_wear) else 0
  # Consume mask if wearing
  if i.adoption_state == 1:
    i.mask_inventory = max(0, i.mask_inventory - daily_mask_consumption_if_wearing)
  # Purchase decision
  if i.mask_inventory < min_inventory_threshold_to_purchase:
    desire = risk_term + (1 if mandate_active else 0) - cost_term
    if desire > 0:
      create_purchase_request(i)
notes: Utility captures tradeoff between perceived benefit and cost.
Inventory acts as a hard constraint when zero.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Computes daily observables and aggregates for evaluation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(Person.adoption_state)
mandate_flag = 1 if mandate_active else 0
# Violation rate: share of present-in-mandate non-wear events
violation_rate = compute_violation_rate()
stockout_share = retailer_stockout_share
# Neighbor influence index: corr(neighbor adoption, individual adoption probability proxy)
for each Person i:
  neigh = neighbors(i)
  neigh_adopt = mean(adoption_state(j) for j in neigh) if len(neigh)>0 else 0
  pairs.append((neigh_adopt, adoption_state(i)))
neighbor_influence_corr = pearson_correlation(pairs)
# Adoption by income quintile
quintiles = income_quintiles(Person.income)
adopt_by_quint = [mean(adoption_state for persons in Q) for Q in quintiles]
emit all observables for the day
notes: Violation rate computed using presence logs and mandate status.
Neighbor correlation uses current adoption as a proxy; can be extended to use p_wear if saved.

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Generate small-world network with parameters (n, k, p).
algorithms.MarkovMovement: Sample next location type using transition matrix and assign to capacity-weighted location.
algorithms.LogitAdoption: Adoption probability via logistic function of risk, conformity, trust/policy, cost, inventory.
algorithms.DifferenceInDifferences: Compute DiD using pre- and post-mandate windows.
algorithms.PearsonCorrelation: Compute correlation between neighbor adoption and individual adoption.
